versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1

- Documentation update: clarified behavioral details in SKILL.md, specifically disclosing that the skill stops/restarts the gateway container and may send up to 300 characters of backend response to Telegram.
- No code or functional changes; all behavior remains the same.

sentinel-modality-router-check v1.0.0

- Initial release of a skill to verify Sentinel's PII redaction and correct model routing in a modality-aware LiteLLM router setup.
- Automatically tests two backend models: a text model (Ollama) and a vision model (SmolVLM-Instruct), based on whether the input contains an image.
- Confirms both redaction and routing correctness by sending direct HTTP probes for each modality and inspecting raw backend responses.
- Supports scheduled or on-demand runs, with optional Jaeger trace lookup for debugging.
- Sends results via Telegram if configured.
- Companion and extension to the earlier sentinel-custom-provider-check, updated for setups supporting multiple backends behind the same gateway.
